concern_results.conclusion: Every-component marker probe in both hooks recognises checkouts under ancestors named skills/hooks/scripts; markdown reaches the checkpoint only on the shared surface; owner-named reason is correctly gated on EXTRACTION_OWNER not in loaded; traced decision table rows all match the code.

Scope detection is read-only stat probes on agent-supplied paths; no new deny path, write, or secret read; the reason echoes only the path the agent itself supplied; plugin-cache and .codex exemptions preserved on both surfaces.

Malformed patches still return before scope detection; the empty-candidate guard prevents the reproduced bash 3.2 set -u 'parts[@]: unbound variable' failure; the component loop is bounded by path components and the 40-candidate cap; out-of-scope edits return base without spending the one checkpoint attempt.

Six new checkpoint cases plus the stop-backstop ancestor case each fail on the prior hook by inspection (old code returns {} or misses the nested root); the precision fixtures (skills tree without marker, cache copy carrying the marker, .codex copy, owner loaded) pin both false-positive and false-negative directions; the spent-attempt row is covered by pre-existing single-attempt cases.

Non-ccl repositories see no behavior change since the marker file defines scope; relative candidates keep prior not-in-scope behavior via the '.' prefix guard; denials per actor/context remain one; the only new input class is shared-surface markdown, as declared.

Reverting the hook commit restores the prior checkpoint; the stop backstop's scope widening is intentional, once per session and fail-open; plan, reference and register record the landed firing point and its limits for rollback diagnosis.

The deny reason names the first shared target path and the extraction owner at the moment of the edit, which is the diagnosis point the change exists to serve; no hidden state or silent decision changes.

The reference bullet, register row and plan claims (every-component probe, six attributed mutations, one replan per actor/context, Edit/Write/patch tools only, no charter proof, late-plan disclosure) are each carried by the diff; no absolutes or unsupported causal claims found.

Shared-gate change is confined to one scoped input class and the reason text of an existing bounded one-shot checkpoint; the Bash-written-edit bypass and the first-edit-elsewhere spend are documented limits in the plan and reference, not silent gaps.

hooks/AGENTS.md requirements met: deterministic validation (check-ccl-skills.sh on the candidate, git diff --check) plus independent review/challenge; root AGENTS.md RED-baseline rule satisfied by tests that fail on the prior hook; no sanitization, routing-surface or scope-control violations in the changed text.
